simple.prompt: She studied diligently every evening, ___ she passed the professional certification exam.
simple.explanation: 'So' adalah coordinating conjunction yang menghubungkan sebab (studied diligently) dengan akibat/hasil logis (passed the exam).

simple.prompt: The flight was delayed ___ there was an unexpected mechanical fault on the aircraft.
simple.explanation: 'Because' adalah subordinating conjunction yang memperkenalkan alasan atau penyebab ('karena ada kerusakan mesin').
hints: Menunjukkan alasan atau sebab di balik peristiwa.

simple.targetSentence: He worked hard but he did not succeed.
simple.explanation: Klausa pertama + coordinating conjunction 'but' + klausa pertentangan kedua.

simple.prompt: You can pay with a credit card, ___ you can settle the bill in cash.
simple.explanation: 'Or' digunakan untuk menghubungkan dua alternatif pilihan (options/alternatives).

simple.targetSentence: Although it was raining we enjoyed the concert.
simple.explanation: Although + dependent clause (it was raining) + main clause (we enjoyed the concert).

simple.prompt: He is talented ___ hardworking, making him a valuable asset to the engineering team.
simple.explanation: 'And' menghubungkan dua ide positif yang setara dan saling melengkapi (talented and hardworking).
hints: Menghubungkan dua sifat positif yang setara.

simple.targetSentence: I listened to music while I was cooking.
simple.explanation: Main clause (I listened to music) + while + continuous clause (I was cooking).

simple.prompt: The presentation was clear, ___ the Q&A session ran fifteen minutes overtime.
simple.explanation: Dua klausa dengan makna kontras/berlawanan dihubungkan oleh coordinating conjunction 'but'.
hints: Apakah kedua gagasan searah atau bertentangan?

simple.prompt: It started raining heavily, ___ we moved the team photo indoors.
simple.explanation: Klausa kedua adalah akibat langsung dari klausa pertama, sehingga dihubungkan oleh 'so'.

simple.prompt: We stayed at the library ___ it offered quiet study rooms and fast Wi-Fi.
simple.explanation: Klausa kedua memberikan alasan ('karena'), sehingga memakai subordinating conjunction 'because'.

simple.prompt: ___ the traffic was heavy, our keynote speaker arrived ten minutes early.
simple.explanation: Meskipun macet, pembicara datang awal — pertentangan antar-klausa memakai 'Although'.
hints: Kedua ide berlawanan (macet vs datang cepat).

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang rencana pengiriman barang.
dialogue: Client
Can we receive both the monitor and the docking station today?
Clerk
We can ship the monitor today, ___ the docking station arrives tomorrow.
simple.explanation: Menambahkan informasi sejajar antara pengiriman hari ini dan esok secara netral memakai 'and'.

simple.prompt: Please text me ___ you arrive at the main railway terminal.
simple.explanation: 'When' menghubungkan perintah dengan waktu kejadian saat tiba di stasiun.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan ganda konjungsi ('Although ... but') yang sangat umum terjadi.
simple.draft: Although the user manual is brief, but it covers every essential safety step.
options: Although the user manual is brief, it covers every essential safety step.
Although the user manual is brief, so it covers every essential safety step.
Because the user manual is brief, but it covers every essential safety step.
simple.explanation: Bahasa Inggris TIDAK boleh menggabungkan 'Although' dan 'but' dalam satu kalimat; cukup gunakan salah satunya saja.
hints: Satu hubungan pertentangan hanya butuh satu konjungsi.

simple.prompt: Would you prefer ___ tea ___ coffee during the afternoon workshop?
simple.explanation: Pasangan korelatif untuk menanyakan pilihan di antara dua opsi adalah 'either ... or'.
hints: Periksa pasangan yang benar secara berurutan.

simple.targetSentence: If the battery light turns red, please plug in the charger.
simple.explanation: Conditional klausa 'If + S + V' di awal diikuti koma sebelum klausa utama.
hints: Awali dengan 'If the battery light turns red,'.
Lanjutkan instruksi 'please plug in the charger'.

simple.targetSentence: We labeled every power cable so that technicians can trace faults easily.
simple.explanation: 'So that' menjelaskan tujuan dari tindakan memberi label kabel.
hints: Mulai dengan 'We labeled every power cable'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di rapat perencanaan dengan correlative conjunction 'both ... and'.
dialogue: Project Manager
Which operating systems will our mobile software support?
Lead Architect
The app will be fully compatible with ___ iOS and Android.
intermediate.explanation: Pasangan korelatif dari 'and' adalah 'both': 'both iOS and Android' (baik iOS maupun Android).

intermediate.prompt: We can schedule the demonstration ___ on Thursday afternoon or on Friday morning.
intermediate.explanation: Pasangan korelatif dari 'or' adalah 'either': 'either ... or' (salah satu dari dua kemungkinan).

intermediate.prompt: The candidate has ___ the required educational credentials nor the practical field experience.
intermediate.explanation: Pasangan korelatif dari 'nor' adalah 'neither': 'neither ... nor' (tidak A dan tidak pula B).

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan correlative conjunction 'not only ... but also'.
intermediate.targetSentence: She is not only intelligent but also very kind.
intermediate.explanation: Pola: Subject + Verb + not only + Adjective 1 (intelligent) + but also + Adjective 2 (very kind).
hints: Mulai dengan 'She is not only intelligent'.

intermediate.prompt: You cannot access the corporate portal ___ you configure two-factor authentication.
intermediate.explanation: 'Unless' bermakna 'kecuali jika / jika tidak' (if not). Kalimat bermakna: Anda tidak bisa mengakses portal kecuali jika Anda mengaktifkan 2FA.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan konjungsi tujuan 'so that'.
intermediate.targetSentence: We left early so that we could avoid the morning traffic.
intermediate.explanation: 'So that + modal clause' digunakan untuk menyatakan maksud atau tujuan (purpose).
hints: Klausa tujuan: 'so that we could avoid the morning traffic'.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih konjungsi kontras formal yang tepat dalam dialog.
dialogue: Director
How did the pilot rollout proceed?
Project Lead
The team achieved its milestones, ___ the timeline was exceptionally tight.
intermediate.explanation: 'Even though' menyatakan kontras kuat/konsesi yang nyata (meskipun / kendati).
hints: Menyatakan kenyataan yang kontras (meskipun tenggat waktu sangat ketat).

intermediate.prompt: Neither the project manager ___ the senior developers expected such a sudden spike in traffic.
You won't be able to enter the server room ___ you carry an authorized RFID pass.
hints: Jika tidak membawa kartu RFID, Anda tidak bisa masuk.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan kantor dengan membedakan 'while' dan 'whereas'.
dialogue: Analyst
Our Jakarta branch grew 18% this quarter, ___ our Surabaya desk remained flat.
Manager
Let's inspect the regional marketing spend right away.
intermediate.explanation: 'Whereas' menyoroti kontras langsung antara dua situasi atau fakta yang berbeda.
hints: Membandingkan dua cabang dengan tren berlawanan.

intermediate.prompt: Take a spare umbrella with you ___ it starts pouring on your walk home.
intermediate.explanation: 'In case' berarti 'untuk berjaga-jaga kalau-kalau...', dilakukan sebagai langkah antisipasi.

intermediate.prompt: The software passed all security checks; ___, the design team asked for two extra days to refine the icons.
intermediate.explanation: Perhatikan tanda titik koma (;) sebelum rumpang dan koma (,) sesudahnya — ini posisi conjunctive adverb 'however', bukan subordinating conjunction 'although'.
hints: Titik koma + koma memisahkan dua klausa independen dengan adverb penghubung.
'Although' tidak dipakai seperti 'however,' dengan koma langsung setelahnya.

intermediate.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan kesejajaran (parallelism) pada konjungsi korelatif berikut.
intermediate.draft: The training program not only improved typing speed, but also it boosted email clarity.
options: The training program improved not only typing speed, but also email clarity.
The training program not only improved typing speed, and also boosted email clarity.
The training program not only improved typing speed, but also boost email clarity.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam struktur 'not only A but also B', elemen A dan B harus sejajar bentuk gramatikalnya ('not only [noun phrase] but also [noun phrase]').
hints: Pastikan struktur setelah 'not only' dan 'but also' setara.
Letakkan 'improved' sebelum 'not only' agar dua objeknya paralel.

intermediate.prompt: The conference is open to both university students ___ working professionals.
intermediate.explanation: Pasangan tetap konjungsi korelatif 'both' selalu 'and' ('both A and B').
hints: Lihat kata 'both' di depan dua kelompok peserta.

intermediate.prompt: ___ the fact that shipping fees rose sharply, customer satisfaction stayed high.
intermediate.explanation: 'The fact that...' adalah sebuah frasa kata benda panjang (noun phrase + appositive), sehingga di depannya tetap memakai preposisi 'Despite' (bukan conjunction 'Although').
hints: Frasa 'the fact that...' diawali preposisi 'Despite/In spite of'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat berpasangan 'not only ... but also' dengan dua kata kerja sejajar.
intermediate.targetSentence: This tool not only tracks expenses but also generates monthly tax summaries.
intermediate.explanation: Dua verb paralel ('tracks...' dan 'generates...') diletakkan tepat setelah masing-masing bagian korelatif.
hints: Awali dengan 'This tool not only tracks expenses'.
Lengkapi dengan 'but also generates monthly tax summaries'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat syarat bermakna selama/asalkan memakai 'as long as'.
intermediate.targetSentence: You may borrow the studio camera as long as you return it by five.
intermediate.explanation: 'As long as' menyatakan syarat yang harus terus dipenuhi agar izin berlaku.
hints: Mulai dengan 'You may borrow the studio camera'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan umum 'double conjunction' (menggabungkan 'although' dan 'but' bersamaan).
complex.draft: Although the budget was severely constrained, but the engineering team delivered the project on time.
options: Although the budget was severely constrained, the engineering team delivered the project on time.
The budget was severely constrained, but the engineering team delivered the project on time.
Both options above are grammatically correct corrections that eliminate the double conjunction.
complex.explanation: Dalam bahasa Inggris baku, TIDAK BOLEH menggabungkan 'Although' dan 'But' dalam satu kalimat majemuk (double conjunction error). Pilih salah satu: gunakan 'Although' di awal klausa anak TANPA 'but', ATAU gunakan 'but' di antara dua klausa independen.
hints: Jangan mendobel 'although' dan 'but' dalam satu kalimat.
Keduanya merupakan opsi perbaikan yang sah.

complex.prompt: Perhatikan perbedaan konjungsi vs adverb transisi: 'The proposal was innovative; ___, it exceeded our allocated capital expenditure.'
complex.explanation: Diapit oleh titik koma (;) dan koma (,), kata yang menghubungkan dua kalimat independen adalah conjunctive adverb 'however'. 'Although' adalah konjungsi subordinat yang tidak digunakan dengan pola tanda baca ini.
hints: Diapit tanda titik koma (;) dan koma (,).

complex.prompt: Agreement with 'Neither ... nor': 'Neither the director nor the senior analysts ___ available for comment.'
complex.explanation: Aturan Proximity pada 'neither... nor...': Kata kerja bersepakat dengan subjek yang PALING DEKAT. Karena 'the senior analysts' (jamak) berada paling dekat dengan verb, gunakan 'were'.
hints: Subjek terdekat dengan verb adalah 'senior analysts' (jamak).

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat formal dengan konjungsi perbandingan kontras 'whereas'.
complex.targetSentence: Profits grew rapidly whereas operational costs remained stable.
complex.explanation: 'Whereas' digunakan dalam konteks formal untuk mengontraskan dua fakta yang bertolak belakang secara berimbang.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kekeliruan antara konjungsi 'because' dan preposisi 'because of'.
complex.draft: The conference was canceled because the unforeseen flight cancellations across the continent.
options: The conference was canceled because of the unforeseen flight cancellations across the continent.
The conference was canceled because that the unforeseen flight cancellations across the continent.
The conference was canceled so because the unforeseen flight cancellations across the continent.
complex.explanation: Frasa setelahnya adalah frasa kata benda tanpa predikat verb ('the unforeseen flight cancellations...'). Maka wajib menggunakan frasa preposisi 'because of', bukan konjungsi 'because'.
hints: Diikuti oleh frasa kata benda tanpa kata kerja.

complex.prompt: Pilihlah kalimat yang menggunakan parallelism yang sempurna pada correlative conjunction.
options: The program is designed not only to educate students but also to inspire them.
The program is designed not only to educate students but also inspiring them.
The program is not only designed to educate students but also inspires them.
complex.explanation: Aturan paralelisme (parallel structure): Elemen gramatikal setelah 'not only' dan 'but also' harus memiliki bentuk struktur yang identik ('not only TO EDUCATE ... but also TO INSPIRE').
hints: Struktur bentuk setelah 'not only' dan 'but also' harus seimbang/paralel.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog hukum dengan konjungsi syarat formal 'provided that'.
dialogue: Licensor
Can we deploy the proprietary software across foreign servers?
Legal Counsel
Yes, ___ all user data remains encrypted at rest and in transit.
complex.explanation: 'Provided that' (atau 'providing that') adalah konjungsi formal yang bermakna 'dengan syarat bahwa / asalkan' (only if/on the condition that).

complex.prompt: ___ had the press conference begun than reporters started asking about the merger rumors.
complex.explanation: Pasangan mutlak di klausa kedua adalah 'than' ('than reporters started...'). 'No sooner ... than' adalah satu-satunya korelatif yang memakai 'than' ('Hardly' memakai 'when').
hints: Cek kata penghubung di tengah kalimat: 'than'.

complex.prompt: The clinical trial proceeded smoothly, ___ minor calibration delays during the first week.
complex.explanation: Setelah koma hanya ada frasa benda ('minor calibration delays during the first week') tanpa verb; hanya preposisi formal 'notwithstanding' yang tepat di sini.
hints: Periksa apakah ada kata kerja setelah rumpang.
Tanpa verb, konjungsi seperti 'although/even though' salah.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan tanda baca dan penyalahgunaan 'however' sebagai penyambung dua kalimat tanpa titik koma berikut.
complex.draft: Our quarterly revenue exceeded projections, however, operating expenses climbed slightly faster.
options: Our quarterly revenue exceeded projections; however, operating expenses climbed slightly faster.
Our quarterly revenue exceeded projections, although, operating expenses climbed slightly faster.
Our quarterly revenue exceeded projections, however operating expenses climbed slightly faster.
complex.explanation: Menyambung dua klausa independen hanya dengan ', however,' menciptakan comma splice; ganti koma pertama menjadi titik koma (;) atau pakai ', but'.
hints: Gunakan semicolon (;) sebelum 'however,' di antara dua kalimat lengkap.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan akademik mengenai penempatan subjek kata kerja pada 'not only ... but also' dengan inversi.
dialogue: Editor
Your sentence reads: 'Not only the study uncovered new fossils, but also it challenged old timelines.' Is it smooth?
Author
When 'Not only' starts a sentence before a full clause, we must invert it: ___.
options: Not only did the study uncover new fossils, but it also challenged old timelines.
Not only the study did uncover new fossils, but also challenged old timelines.
Not only uncovered the study new fossils, but it also challenged old timelines.
complex.explanation: Jika 'Not only' diletakkan di awal kalimat sebelum subjek, klausa pertama wajib mengalami inversi auxiliary: 'Not only did the study uncover...'.
hints: Periksa susunan inversi setelah 'Not only' di awal kalimat.
Inversi Past Simple menempatkan 'did' sebelum subjek + V1.

complex.prompt: We included a spare fuse in the shipment ___ a voltage surge damages the primary unit.
complex.explanation: Konjungsi formal 'lest' bermakna 'agar jangan sampai / takut-takut kalau...' dan secara klasik sering diikuti subjunctive atau verb dasar/Present.
hints: Maknanya mengantisipasi risiko yang tidak diinginkan ('agar jangan sampai...').

complex.prompt: No matter how carefully a draft is written, typos may still appear; ___, a final read-aloud check remains essential.
complex.explanation: Setelah titik koma dan diikuti koma, adverb penghubung logis sebab-akibat ('oleh karena itu') yang tepat adalah 'consequently'.
hints: Lihat titik koma (;) dan koma (,) mengapit rumpang.
Maknanya kesimpulan logis akibat premis pertama.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan konjungsi tujuan 'so that' vs 'for' pada kalimat laporan penelitian berikut.
complex.draft: The laboratory dimmed all overhead monitors in order that the optical sensors wouldn't misfire.
options: The laboratory dimmed all overhead monitors so that the optical sensors wouldn't misfire.
The laboratory dimmed all overhead monitors for the optical sensors wouldn't misfire.
The laboratory dimmed all overhead monitors because of the optical sensors wouldn't misfire.
complex.explanation: Dalam bahasa Inggris modern baku, konjungsi tujuan sebelum klausa lengkap dengan modal ('wouldn't') adalah 'so that' (jauh lebih alami daripada 'in order that' atau salah pakai 'for/because of').
hints: Konjungsi tujuan modern di depan klausa penuh adalah 'so that'.
Jangan memakai 'because of' atau 'for' sebelum klausa S+V penuh untuk tujuan.

complex.prompt: ___ the audit uncovered minor discrepancies, none of them pointed to deliberate fraud.
complex.explanation: 'While' di awal kalimat sering berfungsi secara elegan sebagai konjungsi konsesif/pertentangan formal bermakna 'Meskipun / Walaupun'.
hints: Ada pertentangan antara adanya ketidaksesuaian kecil dan tidak adanya penipuan.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat konjungsi ganda korelatif 'Hardly ... when' dengan inversi.
complex.targetSentence: Hardly had the doors opened when the first visitors walked in.
complex.explanation: 'Hardly' di awal kalimat memicu inversi Past Perfect ('had + S + V3') dan berpasangan dengan 'when'.
hints: Awali dengan 'Hardly had the doors opened'.
Pasangkan dengan 'when the first visitors walked in'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat formal memakai klausa tujuan 'in order that' atau 'so that' (pilih struktur paling bersih dengan modal).
complex.targetSentence: Engineers isolated the test chamber so that external vibrations would not skew the readings.
complex.explanation: Subjek + verb + objek + so that + subjek kedua + modal ('would not skew') + objek.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Engineers isolated the test chamber'.
